# `aube unlink`

- **Usage:** `aube unlink [-g --global] [PACKAGE]`
- **Aliases:** `dislink`
- **Effect:** modifies state

Unlink a package (remove linked entries from node_modules)

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/dependencies) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`[PACKAGE]`** — Package name to unlink (omit to unlink all linked dependencies)

## Flags

- **`-g --global`** — Operate on the global link registry instead of the current project.

  `aube unlink -g` removes the current package's entry from `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/aube/global-links`, `$HOME/.cache/aube/global-links` when `XDG_CACHE_HOME` is unset, or `%LOCALAPPDATA%\aube\global-links` on Windows; `aube unlink -g <name>` removes the named entry.
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
